verdict.rationale: Docs show Muse can hold goals/tasks that run on a schedule and follow up automatically with notifications (muse-docs-5, muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24), matching the recurring/one-off task story. However, an independent stress test reported the agent's control plane timing out under load, raising doubts about reliability of automated follow-through (muse-comm-1). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of explicit recurrence/scheduling controls (e.g., cron-like intervals), and independent confirmation that scheduled tasks reliably complete and report results under normal use.
